run_train_lightning_main: run the main training loop for the ego-lifter 3D Gaussian Splatting model using Hydra config
run_get_model: run get_model to instantiate the 3D Gaussian Splatting model from config and scene data
run_scene_init: run Scene initialization to load scene data, cameras, and point clouds from config
run_eval_query_2dseg: run eval_query_2dseg to evaluate static and dynamic 2D segmentation mIoU on a dataloader
run_modelcheckpoint_callback: run the ModelCheckpoint callback to save model checkpoints every N training steps
